note: Every string the onboarding funnel shows. Anything marked "placeholder": true is a number or claim we have not earned yet and must be replaced (or the element removed) before submission — App Review treats invented social proof as a rejection. Slide titles and bodies are written to the line rhythm of the reference captures (two-line title, two-line body) so the layout matches; the words are ours.
